purpose: Resolve an external effect only from evidence whose provenance and effect binding are verified by an external trust registry.

rules.rule: A claim cannot resolve an effect unless trusted evidence is bound to the same logical_effect_id and attempt_id.
Claimed source, domain, observation kind, verdict, evidence id, and evidence digest must exactly match a trusted evidence registry entry.
The trusted registry entry must identify a verifier and carry trust level attested or verified.
Invalidated, revoked, superseded, stale, or mismatched evidence cannot resolve an effect.
Trusted evidence must be post-attempt and fresh for the effect decision being resolved.
Model estimates, transport acknowledgements, cached state, and unprovenanced values cannot resolve an effect by themselves.
If provenance, correlation, trust, validity, freshness, or timing cannot be established from the trusted registry, the effect remains UNRESOLVED.

nonclaims: This profile does not define a cryptographic attestation format.
The trusted evidence registry is an external trust root and must itself be protected by the integrating system.
